digest.component_or_area: Cloud rate-limit sweep / adapters/jira transport surface completeness assertion
propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() without a named constant, making the transport surface scope implicit and prone to drift when methods are renamed or moved to unswept sibling modules.

A classified mutating method can exist outside the four swept transport modules only if its body is a pure same-name delegation to self.transport with arguments forwarded unchanged; any additional logic, guard, or argument transform violates the anti-drift constraint.

The unswept jira package modules (acli_subprocess.py, jira_fields.py, and six others) must be scanned to detect drift — currently only backend.py has two known-benign facades (set_relationship, add_comment), and the assertion must remain green against all future module additions.

An AST-based predicate must distinguish pure transport facades (single return statement calling self.transport.<name>) from any method that guards, retries, logs, transforms arguments, or targets non-transport — rejecting the latter to prevent silent removal from the 429 safety sweep.
